facts.fact: Garcia 被排挤：不共享观察、不做笔记——副手 hover/lurk 问个不停。
facts.anchor: Didn’t share any observations, didn’t make any notes.

facts.fact: Kevin 病房有副手——不愿说话；Garcia 躲起来打这通电话。
facts.anchor: but there was a deputy there too. He didn’t want to speak

facts.fact: Dana：April 喊到嗓子出血——没人听见；独自、冰冷、死在水里。
facts.anchor: She screamed her throat bloody, but out there, there was no one to hear her.

facts.fact: Dana 拒绝离开：不会让它发生在任何人身上——但黄蜂般的副手让没法干活。
facts.anchor: I’m not letting that happen to anybody else.

facts.fact: 名单上只剩一个名字——Alex 自己。
facts.anchor: then there’s only one other name on that list—

facts.fact: 从腐败直接滑向疯狂——对 Walker 的忠诚压过胸前的警徽。
facts.anchor: their loyalties to Walker and his friends outweighed the badges on their chest.

facts.fact: 章末：「Watch your back——这镇上没有别人会替你看着。」
facts.anchor: no one else is going to do it for you.

facts.fact: Alex 判 Lacey：不怪她的无能、天真、错置信任——这房子不是她盖的。
facts.anchor: Not for her ineptitude, her naïvety, her misplaced trust—none of it.
